cwe_name: Inclusion of Web Functionality from an Untrusted Source

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: CWE-830 requires inclusion of actual web functionality/widgets from untrusted sources. This code configures security origins for Flash but does not demonstrate inclusion of external functionality.

connection.evidence: User-controlled trustedOrigins option flows to Flash security configuration via flashvars parameter

diff_causality.evidence: The added line constructs the trustedOrigins parameter that configures Flash security settings

security_control.evidence: Only URL encoding is applied; no validation of origin format or security constraints
security_control.required_control: Origin validation and security constraint enforcement
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-830 requires preventing inclusion of untrusted functionality; proper origin validation is essential
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No validation of origin format, protocol restrictions, or security constraints beyond basic encoding

concrete_impact.evidence: Impact depends on Flash's interpretation of trustedOrigins; no demonstrated security consequence

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the trustedOrigins parameter would not be included in the flashvars, potentially affecting Flash security configuration.
supporting_evidence: User-controlled trustedOrigins option flows to Flash security configuration
No validation beyond URL encoding of origin values
contradicting_evidence: CWE-830 requires actual inclusion of web functionality/widgets, not just security configuration
Flash security configuration is not equivalent to including external functionality
unresolved_facts: Whether Flash imposes validation constraints on origin values
Impact of malformed or malicious origin values on Flash security
